high_level_description: This image depicts the interior of a grand library with an ornate ceiling frescoed with classical figures and scenes. The ceiling is highly detailed, featuring numerous angelic and human figures engaged in various activities, such as reading, writing, and holding scrolls. The frescoes are rich in color, primarily using shades of red, gold, blue, and white, which give the space a majestic and historical feel. The library itself is spacious and symmetrical, with tall bookshelves lining both sides of the room.
